items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: It was written by Biddle, Attorney Biddle

ctx.x: I don't know. I've been trying to track down his music for a good while, and I don't seem to be able to come up with anything. He should be a member of ASCAP, and ASCAP should have the record of his music and (?) publisher. He's documented somewhere. William Grant Still has different publishers. His "Ballad For Americans" written during the Second World War was a bit radical to people, but the lyric, the words... It was written by Biddle, Attorney Biddle, who at that time was under the Roosevelt Administration --…
